name: Godiva
source:
Rachel’s close friend who lives in the neighboring village. A boyish girl with a short haircut.
Strong sense of justice and a tomboyish personality. She comes from a relatively well-off family in the village and dresses better than the other villagers.

Hearing that Rachel is being toyed with by the Demon of Lust, she rushes to help her at once.
After she saves Rachel who has only gotten her “Fear” back and is on the verge of going mad, she cannot leave her as she is, and accompanies her on the journey to reclaim her heart.

[From the [url=https://www.ordin-soft.com/snowwhite.html]official website[/url]]
